description: This is a unit test class for the ReplaceWithValuePurgeStrategy in the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing the purge functionality and strategy retrieval for employee data anonymization or data purging.

classes.name: ReplaceWithValuePurgeStrategyTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for testing the ReplaceWithValuePurgeStrategy related to employee data purging in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, sets up the strategy, loads fixture data, and prepares the test subject.

methods.name: testPurge
methods.description: Tests the purge method to ensure employee fields are correctly replaced by purge values.

methods.name: testPurgeRecord
methods.description: Tests existing employee record purging and verifies field values after purge.

methods.name: testGetReplaceStrategy
methods.description: Verifies the correct instantiation of various replace strategies based on their class names.

methods.name: invokeProtectedGetReplaceStrategy
methods.description: Helper method to invoke the protected getReplaceStrategy method from the class under test.
